say:0:1310301001:0.text: The scenery here is really something, isn't it?
say:0:1310301001:0.source_cn: 这里的景色真别致，泡温泉肯定很放松。

say:1:1310301002:0.text: Chippy can see the hot springs from here!
say:1:1310301002:0.source_cn: 满满在这儿都闻到温泉的味道啦！

say:2:1310302001:1.text: Welcome, honored guests, to the Frozen Paw!
say:2:1310302001:1.source_cn: 尊敬的客人们，欢迎光临“白熊温泉旅馆”！

say:3:1310302002:1.text: Are you here to participate in the Ghostly Getaway activity?
say:3:1310302002:1.source_cn: 请问各位是来参加冬日祭典“鬼影密室”项目的吗？

say:4:1310302003:1.text: So that's the one everyone's talking about, the "most thrilling and popular" activity, right?
say:4:1310302003:1.source_cn: 原来“最有趣、最刺激、最受欢迎”的祭典项目叫鬼影密室呀！

choice_prompt:5:1310302003.text: So that's the one everyone's talking about, the "most thrilling and popular" activity, right?
choice_prompt:5:1310302003.source_cn: 原来“最有趣、最刺激、最受欢迎”的祭典项目叫鬼影密室呀！

say:6:1310302004:1.text: Think of it as a test of both your wit and courage. You'll have to escape from a pitch-black room, and trust me, the realism will have your heart racing!
say:6:1310302004:1.source_cn: 您可以将它理解为“利用智慧与勇气，从黑暗密室中逃脱”的...

say:7:1310302005:1.text: Please head inside and a staff member will explain all the details to you.
say:7:1310302005:1.source_cn: 请您前往旅店内，会有专门负责的员工为您介绍更详细的规则的。

say:8:1310302008:1.text: It sounds amazing... Chippy wants to try both the escape room and the hot springs...
say:8:1310302008:1.source_cn: 听起来好棒啊……满满既想参加鬼影密室项目，又想泡温泉……

say:9:1310302009:1.text: Can we take a look at the hot springs?

say:10:1310302010:0.text: Of course! You're welcome to explore the inn.
say:10:1310302010:0.source_cn: 当然可以！各位客人请随意在旅馆内游览。

say:11:1310302011:0.text: If you plan to soak in the hot springs, make sure to put on a towel! It's best not to wear your regular clothes there.
say:11:1310302011:0.source_cn: 客人们如果要泡温泉，还请先更换浴衣，最好不要穿着日常服...

say:13:1310302006:0.text: The Frozen Paw is the biggest and coziest hot springs inn around Cedartown. It's a bit on the pricier side, but absolutely worth it.
say:13:1310302006:0.source_cn: “白熊温泉旅馆”是雪松镇周围最大、最舒适的温泉旅馆，绝...

say:14:1310302007:1.text: We've got a great reputation here in Cedartown, and that's why we're handling such a major activity like the Ghostly Getaway!
say:14:1310302007:1.source_cn: 我们的旅馆在整个雪松镇有口皆碑。正因如此，我们才能承担...

say:0:1310303001:0.text: Just head straight, and you'll see the hot springs ahead.
say:0:1310303001:0.source_cn: 各位继续向前就可以看到温泉了。

say:1:1310303002:0.text: Don't forget to change first if you're going in!
say:1:1310303002:0.source_cn: 进入温泉之前请记得更衣哦！

say:2:1310306001:1.source_cn: 主、主人……这里到底发生了什么？！

say:3:1310306002:1.text: The inn's been completely ransacked... did someone rob the place? Are all the staff... dead?
say:3:1310306002:1.source_cn: 旅店里被弄得乱七八糟的，像是被人抢劫了一样……这些店员...

say:4:1310306003:1.text: We need to check on them quickly. Maybe there are some survivors.
say:4:1310306003:1.source_cn: 我们得赶紧检查一下这些店员，或许还能救活一些幸运儿……

say:5:1310306004:1.text: Look at that body over there... those bunny ears... they look kind of familiar.
say:5:1310306004:1.source_cn: 主人，你看那边躺着的那具尸体……那双兔子耳朵……看起来...
say:5:1310306004:1.male: Look at that body over there... those bunny ears... they look kind of familiar.
say:5:1310306004:1.female: Look at that body over there... those bunny ears... they look kind of familiar.

say:1:1310309001:0.text: You're here for the festival too, right? Oh look! Chippy's waking up!
say:1:1310309001:0.source_cn: 你们也是来参加祭典的吧……哎呀，满满，你总算醒了。

say:3:1310309002:0.text: Lorsan, you really scared Chippy just now! You looked...
say:3:1310309002:0.source_cn: 洛桑，你刚才也太吓人了吧！我还以为你……

say:4:1310309003:0.text: Sorry, sorry! Um... please, just don't tell Lyca about this. She'll totally yank my ears!
say:4:1310309003:0.source_cn: 抱歉抱歉。那个……拜托了，可千万别把这件事告诉莱卡，不...

say:5:1310309004:1.text: What are you doing here, playing pranks and scaring people?
say:5:1310309004:1.source_cn: 你怎么会在这里恶作剧吓唬别人？

say:6:1310309005:0.text: Oh, well, I sent you a letter about heading north! And I heard some merchants raving about this famous festival, so I figured I'd check it out.
say:6:1310309005:0.source_cn: 我之前给你们写过信说要来北方游历呀！我在路上听到一些商...

say:7:1310309006:0.text: Aaand... I kind of needed some money, so... now I'm working for this lovely innkeeper! Gotta fund the adventure somehow!
say:7:1310309006:0.source_cn: 至于刚才嘛……我只是在给这位美丽的老板娘打工而已，毕竟...

say:10:1310309007:1.text: Oh my, did we scare you? Wasn't that a thrill? We planned this little act for the Ghostly Getaway to start things off with a bit of a bang.
say:10:1310309007:1.source_cn: 哈哈，这位客人被吓到了吗？是不是很刺激？这可是我们为了...

say:11:1310309008:1.text: It looks like it worked... but don't worry too much, darling. A festival needs a little excitement to really come to life.
say:11:1310309008:1.source_cn: 看来还是挺有效果……啊，抱歉抱歉，不要介意哦。祭典嘛，...

say:12:1310309009:1.text: It wasn't scary at all! Chippy just, um, wasn't ready for it!
say:12:1310309009:1.source_cn: 其实……一点也不可怕！嗯，满满刚才只是没准备好……

choice_prompt:13:1310309009.text: It wasn't scary at all! Chippy just, um, wasn't ready for it!
choice_prompt:13:1310309009.source_cn: 其实……一点也不可怕！嗯，满满刚才只是没准备好……

say:14:1310309010:1.text: What you felt just now? That was just a "tease", a mere appetizer. The real fun is about to begin.
say:14:1310309010:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，刚才的只能算是个“小惊吓”，一盘开胃前菜而已。

say:15:1310309011:1.text: Oh dear, I never properly introduced myself. I'm Gerda, the owner of this lovely place. Pleased to meet you!
say:15:1310309011:1.source_cn: 忘了自我介绍，我是这里的老板娘格尔达。

say:18:1310309012:1.text: Madam Gerda, I was wondering why this inn is called the Frozen Paw.
say:18:1310309012:1.source_cn: 咦，格尔达女士，为什么这家店的名字要叫“白熊温泉旅店”呢？

say:19:1310309013:1.text: Hahaha... Because my best friend has lovely white paws, and she would get ice on them when winter came. Unfortunately, she prefers the comforts of our village too much to move to Cedartown.
say:19:1310309013:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，亲爱的，因为我最好的朋友是位可爱的白熊女士。可...

say:20:1310309014:1.text: I understand now. You opened this inn in honor of her, right?
say:20:1310309014:1.source_cn: 我明白了！所以你就用她的名字在这里开了家旅店，对吧？

say:21:1310309015:1.text: That's right, darling. If you have the chance to visit my village, you'll find that my friend opened a shop called the Brown Paw Clothier. *Giggle* We're just like two peas in a pod.
say:21:1310309015:1.source_cn: 正是这样，亲爱的。要是你们有机会去我家乡一趟，就会发现...

say:22:1310309016:1.text: You two must have a special friendship!
say:22:1310309016:1.source_cn: 哇，真是令人羡慕的友情！

say:23:1310309017:1.text: Alright, everyone, come with me. What's next will really make your head spin!
say:23:1310309017:1.source_cn: 好啦，大家随我来吧，接下来的才是真正的大餐呢！

choice:13:0:1.text: So this is the Ghostly Getaway?
choice:13:0:1.male: So this is the Ghostly Getaway?
choice:13:0:1.female: So this is the Ghostly Getaway?

say:3:1310310002:1.text: This path seems to lead to the basement. Is the event down there?
say:3:1310310002:1.source_cn: 这里好像通往地下室……这个项目是在地下举办的？

say:4:1310310003:1.text: Of course! Where else would it be as dark and quiet as midnight?
say:4:1310310003:1.source_cn: 当然啦，亲爱的。只有地下才能随时都像深夜般漆黑无光、寂...

say:5:1310310004:1.text: Imagine this: pitch-black surroundings, then suddenly, a flicker of green flame... and in the shadows, someone's watching. Silent. Unseen.
say:5:1310310004:1.source_cn: 想想看，在这样的环境里，你的眼前突然出现了一朵绿色的火...

say:6:1310310005:1.text: That's terrifying! Um, no, Chippy c-can't wait...
say:6:1310310005:1.source_cn: 哇！听起来好可怕……不，不可怕！

say:7:1310310006:1.text: Haha! Don't worry, this activity's perfect for a brave little adventurer like you. Here, take this rulebook. Once you're ready, head to the preparation area.
say:7:1310310006:1.source_cn: 哈哈，当然，这样的项目正适合勇敢的仓鼠先生。喏，这是“...

say:8:1310310007:1.text: First one to escape wins a petal!
say:8:1310310007:1.source_cn: 第一位走出密室的朋友就是赢家，能得到一枚花瓣！

say:1:1310310101:1.text: I assume you've read the rules for the Ghostly Getaway?
say:1:1310310101:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们应该已经阅读过鬼影密室的规则书了。

say:2:1310310102:1.text: Before entering, I need to confirm with all of you to ensure that both your minds and bodies can handle an appropriate level of fright.
say:2:1310310102:1.source_cn: 在进入密室之前， 我必须和你们确认，确保你们的身心足够...

say:5:1310310103:1.text: Don't worry! We're all brave adults! We can handle a little scare.
say:5:1310310103:1.source_cn: 放心！我们都是成熟的、勇敢的大人了！肯定没问题的！

say:8:1310310104:1.text: Alright then, in you go. Enjoy your experience!
say:8:1310310104:1.source_cn: 那么亲爱的，请进吧。祝你们游玩愉快！

say:5:1310311001:1.text: Seems like the Ghostly Getaway has us playing the role of outsiders, trying to escape from a haunted mansion filled with the undead!
say:5:1310311001:1.source_cn: 看来这个鬼影密室是要我们扮演外乡人，想办法从这座充满活...

say:6:1310311002:0.text: The journal mentioned the master of the house murdering his wife... There's gotta be some scary moments in here!
say:6:1310311002:0.source_cn: 日记里还提到了男主人谋杀他妻子的事……呀，这个密室里肯...

say:7:1310311003:0.text: Don't worry, Chippy's a brave knight! Chippy will protect you!
say:7:1310311003:0.source_cn: 没关系，满满是勇敢的骑士，满满可以挡在你的前面！

say:10:1310311006:0.text: Sounds like someone's calling our names.
say:10:1310311006:0.source_cn: 好像有人在走廊喊我们的名字？

say:0:1310311101:0.text: So, this is the Ghostly Getaway. Let's look around for clues, Magister!
say:0:1310311101:0.source_cn: 这里就是鬼影密室？主人，我们先四处看看有什么线索吧！
say:0:1310311101:0.male: So, this is the Ghostly Getaway. Let's look around for clues, Magister!
say:0:1310311101:0.female: So, this is the Ghostly Getaway. Let's look around for clues, Magister!

say:0:1310313001:0.text: The door just closed by itself!

say:1:1310313002:0.text: Is this... has the Ghostly Getaway already started?
say:1:1310313002:0.source_cn: 难道……鬼影密室……已经开始了？

say:0:1310314001:0.text: This door is locked... looks like the only way is forward.
say:0:1310314001:0.source_cn: 这扇门被锁上了……看来只能往前走。
say:0:1310314001:0.male: This door is locked... looks like the only way is forward.
say:0:1310314001:0.female: This door is locked... looks like the only way is forward.

say:1:1310314002:0.text: It's so dark... Magister, d-don't walk too fast!
say:1:1310314002:0.source_cn: 这里好黑啊……主人，别、别走那么快！
say:1:1310314002:0.male: It's so dark... Magister, d-don't walk too fast!
say:1:1310314002:0.female: It's so dark... Magister, d-don't walk too fast!

say:0:1310315001:0.text: Is this a painting of a couple? They look so happy...
say:0:1310315001:0.source_cn: 哇，这幅画上应该是一对夫妻吧，他们看上去很幸福呢……

say:1:1310315002:0.text: But part of the painting is missing. People who damage art are the worst!
say:1:1310315002:0.source_cn: 可惜这幅画缺了一块，不完整了……破坏艺术品的人真讨厌！

say:0:1310317001:0.text: Was that... a staff member? Or an actual g-g-ghost?
say:0:1310317001:0.source_cn: 刚才那个……是密室的工作人员吧？千万别是幽灵……

say:1:1310317002:0.text: Is there something on the ground?
say:1:1310317002:0.source_cn: 好黑啊，满满，地上是不是有什么东西？

say:6:1310318001:1.text: Oh, turns out it was a bouquet of roses. What a shame, they're all withered.
say:6:1310318001:1.source_cn: 这里有一束玫瑰花……好可惜，都枯萎了。

say:7:1310318002:0.text: And there's also... a torn piece of cloth?
say:7:1310318002:0.source_cn: 咦？这又是什么……一块碎了的布？

choice_prompt:10:1310318002.text: And there's also... a torn piece of cloth?
choice_prompt:10:1310318002.source_cn: 咦？这又是什么……一块碎了的布？

say:11:1310318003:1.text: Hmm, it looks like a painting of someone's finger, and they're wearing a ring!
say:11:1310318003:1.source_cn: 仔细看看，上面真的还有图案呢……好像是一个人的手指，还...

say:12:1310318004:1.text: Wait! Doesn't this look like it could fit into that painting we saw earlier?
say:12:1310318004:1.source_cn: 诶？这个形状……好像可以拼在刚才那幅油画上啊！

say:13:1310318007:0.text: Let's try <style="highlight">putting it in the painting</style>! Hehe, maybe it'll give us a clue to escape.
say:13:1310318007:0.source_cn: 我们<style=highlight>把这块碎片拼到刚...

say:14:1310318008:0.text: What about the roses? Should we take them with us?
say:14:1310318008:0.source_cn: 那这束玫瑰，我们还要带着吗？

say:17:1310318009:0.text: Of course! Based on our past experiences, Chippy knows that strange items always end up being useful!
say:17:1310318009:0.source_cn: 那当然了！以满满跟着主人的经验，我们找到的奇怪物品，一...
say:17:1310318009:0.male: Of course! Based on our past experiences, Chippy knows that strange items always end up being useful!
say:17:1310318009:0.female: Of course! Based on our past experiences, Chippy knows that strange items always end up being useful!

say:18:1310318010:1.text: And they're light. They can fit into Chippy's knapsack!
say:18:1310318010:1.source_cn: 反正它也不重……可以放进满满的背包里！

say:20:1310318005:1.text: Yes! I bet it's the missing piece from that painting we saw earlier!
say:20:1310318005:1.source_cn: 对呀！这不就是刚才那幅油画上缺少的那一块吗？

say:21:1310318006:1.text: Looking more closely... I can see it's a painting of a part of the hand, and he's wearing a ring.
say:21:1310318006:1.source_cn: 仔细看看，这块碎片上面画的应该是那位男士的手吧，还戴着...

say:1:1310319002:0.text: Chippy sees now. Completing the painting gave us a clue!
say:1:1310319002:0.source_cn: 满满明白了，拼油画是一个获得线索的方法！

say:5:1310320001:1.text: That photo was all scratched up. Seems like that couple had relationship problems...
say:5:1310320001:1.source_cn: 刚才的照片上都是划痕……油画上那对夫妻，他们的感情似乎...

say:6:1310320002:1.text: The text under that photo looks like it was written by the wife... Oh, it's so sad!
say:6:1310320002:1.source_cn: 那张照片下的文字像是女主人写的，她的丈夫酗酒，酒后打人...

choice_prompt:7:1310320002.text: The text under that photo looks like it was written by the wife... Oh, it's so sad!
choice_prompt:7:1310320002.source_cn: 那张照片下的文字像是女主人写的，她的丈夫酗酒，酒后打人……唉，这谁能受得了啊！

say:8:1310320003:1.text: Hmm, the traveler's journal we found earlier said the husband killed her!
say:8:1310320003:1.source_cn: 唔，我们一进来看到的旅人日记里说那个男主人杀了他的妻子！

say:9:1310320004:1.text: Do you think maybe she was planning to leave him, and in a fit of rage, he did something awful...?
say:9:1310320004:1.source_cn: 难道是因为他妻子打算和他分手，他一时冲动，就动了手？

say:10:1310320007:1.text: It seems like their love turned into hatred. Chippy wonders how it ends...
say:10:1310320007:1.source_cn: 看来这是一对夫妻从相爱走向相互憎恨的故事……不知道结局...

say:11:1310320008:1.text: If my interpretation is correct, these clues should help us find and open the door.
say:11:1310320008:1.source_cn: 如果我们的解读是正确的，这些信息应该能帮助我们找到和打...

say:12:1310320009:1.text: But we're still missing something. Let's keep looking.
say:12:1310320009:1.source_cn: 不过现在我们知道的还不够多，再四处找找看有没有其他线索吧。

say:14:1310320005:1.text: It sounds like the wife wanted to take revenge.
say:14:1310320005:1.source_cn: 他的妻子，似乎想要报复他呢……

say:15:1310320006:1.text: But the journal earlier said she ultimately died at his hands...
say:15:1310320006:1.source_cn: 可我记得旅人的日记里说，他妻子最后死在他的手下……

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 照片里透露出一些信息

say:0:1310321001:0.text: That door ahead... could it be the exit?!
say:0:1310321001:0.source_cn: 前面那扇门……难道是出口？！

say:1:1310321002:0.text: Wow, awesome! We'll be the first ones out!
say:1:1310321002:0.source_cn: 哇！太棒了！咱们一定是第一个出去的！

narration:0:1310322001:1.text: After a wave of dizziness, you find yourselves back outside the first room.

say:0:1310323001:0.text: That door was fake! We got teleported back here!
say:0:1310323001:0.source_cn: 那扇门是假的！我们被传送回来了！

say:1:1310323002:0.text: Listen, I hear multiple doors opening!
say:1:1310323002:0.source_cn: 听，好像是好几个房间门打开的声音！

say:0:1310324001:0.source_cn: 啊啊啊！！什么东西！吓死人了！

say:1:1310324002:0.text: Oh, that painting! How'd it fall onto the ground?
say:1:1310324002:0.source_cn: 是那幅画！它怎么无缘无故地掉在地上了……

say:5:1310325001:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look, it's different from before!
say:5:1310325001:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look, it's different from before!
say:5:1310325001:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look, it's different from before!

say:6:1310325002:1.text: Whoa, someone ripped it apart! Three pieces are missing. It's like someone took out all their anger on it...
say:6:1310325002:1.source_cn: 哇，谁把画撕成这样了，还缺了三块碎片……就好像是把一肚...

choice_prompt:7:1310325002.text: Whoa, someone ripped it apart! Three pieces are missing. It's like someone took out all their anger on it...
choice_prompt:7:1310325002.source_cn: 哇，谁把画撕成这样了，还缺了三块碎片……就好像是把一肚子气都发在了这幅画像上一样。

say:8:1310325003:1.text: Chippy's sure that if we find the pieces and finish it, we'll get another clue.
say:8:1310325003:1.source_cn: 是哦……跟之前一样，找到碎片拼好这幅画，应该就能找到下...

say:9:1310325004:1.text: The painting's in shreds, just like the couple's relationship...

say:11:1310357006:0.text: Hmmm... But to me, the very existence of the Graveborn defies the natural order.
say:11:1310357006:0.source_cn: 嗯……我知道。只是……在我看来，亡灵眷族的存在就有悖于...

say:12:1310357007:0.text: The cycle of life—seasons change, things are born and die, decay and renewal. But the Graveborn... they're stuck in immortality, wandering among the living. It is an aberration.
say:12:1310357007:0.source_cn: 自然循环——四季交替，生老病死，枯亡新生。但亡灵……死...

say:13:1310357008:0.text: The more blurred the boundary between life and death becomes, the less respect people have for death... and the less they value life itself.
say:13:1310357008:0.source_cn: 死亡与生命的界限越模糊，人们便越不敬重死亡，也就越不热...

say:14:1310357009:0.text: Uh, sorry to break up the chat, but... should we still be chasing those Graveborn?
say:14:1310357009:0.source_cn: 各位，打断一下，我们还要继续追踪那两个亡灵吗？

say:15:1310357010:0.text: They do not seem particularly dangerous, and I doubt they will return anytime soon. There's little need for concern.
say:15:1310357010:0.source_cn: 他们没有恶意，应该暂时不会回来了，我想不用太过担心。

say:16:1310357011:0.text: Even I can't sense them anymore. They must be long gone by now...
say:16:1310357011:0.source_cn: 的确，连我都已经听不到他们的动静了，想必跑得很远了吧……

say:17:1310357012:0.text: Ah, you're a Windwhisperer, I see! Ha, well met, Windwhisperer. I am Faramor of Shorehaven, at your service.
say:17:1310357012:0.source_cn: 原来你是风语者！哈，风语者阁下，临湾地的法拉莫尔，向您问好。

say:18:1310357013:0.text: Whoa! Skip the whole "at your service" thing, alright? Just call me Lorsan. I'm just a humble Windwhisperer out on a little adventure!
say:18:1310357013:0.source_cn: 哇哦，不不不，不是什么“阁下”，叫我洛桑就好。我只是个...

say:19:1310357014:0.text: Faramor, huh... I don't recall hearing your name when I was in the Dark Forest. You'd think a guy with your skills would be famous by now.
say:19:1310357014:0.source_cn: 法拉莫尔……我在丛林的时候好像没听过你的名字？奇怪，你...

say:20:1310357015:0.text: I am not of the Dark Forest.

choice_prompt:21:1310357015.text: I am not of the Dark Forest.

say:22:1310357016:0.text: I must report these events to the captain of the Palace Guard. I shall return to Cedartown posthaste.
say:22:1310357016:0.source_cn: 没错，我得尽快将刚才的事件告知宫廷侍卫长。诸位，我先回...

say:25:1310357017:1.text: That works out perfectly! We promised Her Highness we'd make it to the ball on time. It's getting late, so it should be starting soon. Let's go back together!
say:25:1310357017:1.source_cn: 正好，我们答应过公主殿下要去按时参加舞会。现在天色暗了...

say:26:1310357018:0.text: *Sigh* I've gotta return to work at the hot springs inn, or my boss is going to dock my pay. But hey, fingers crossed I'll see you guys at the ball!
say:26:1310357018:0.source_cn: 唉，我得回温泉旅馆干活了，不然，亲爱的老板娘一定会扣我...

choice:7:0:1.text: Your sense of smell is amazing.
choice:7:0:1.male: Your sense of smell is amazing.
choice:7:0:1.female: Your sense of smell is amazing.

say:28:1310357004:0.text: I certainly hope we don't encounter any more. I don't think my nose can endure the putrid stench of decay much longer.
say:28:1310357004:0.source_cn: 真希望别再有更多了，我的鼻子快要受不了这股腐朽的亡灵气...

narration:29:13010352:0.text: A mysterious hooded lady shows up and takes away the Graveborn you have been confronting.
narration:29:13010352:0.source_cn: 一个戴着兜帽的神秘女性出现，带走了与你们对峙的亡灵。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1310304001:.text: We'll have to find some time to relax in the hot springs later.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1310304001:.source_cn: 找个时间，我们舒服地泡一泡温泉吧
cinematic_dialogue:1:1310304001:.male: We'll have to find some time to relax in the hot springs later.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1310304001:.female: We'll have to find some time to relax in the hot springs later.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1310304003:.text: Let's tackle the Ghostly Getaway first!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1310304003:.source_cn: 不过，我们要先去鬼影密室！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1310348001:.text: Come on, it's time to play!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1310348002:.text: Oh no, it's this guy again!
